regions.description: Rolling farmland, orchards and sleepy villages along the river Lune.

regions.name: Northreach
regions.description: Snow, pine forests and the great frost-city of Frostspire.

brindle.name: Brindle
brindle.description: A market town of crooked roofs and apple carts, where the river Lune bends.

anvil.name: Dunmore's Anvil
anvil.owner: Hilda Dunmore, a cheerful dwarf with singed eyebrows

frostspire.name: Frostspire

sunken-tower.name: The Sunken Tower
sunken-tower.description: A wizard's tower half-swallowed by a marsh, leaning like a tired giant.
